clue.text: Leave ground, free transport being withdrawn

parts.note: a lift is a free ride in someone's car
an offer that is off has been called off or withdrawn

explanation.surface: Someone loses their free ride and has to set off on foot.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocket or aircraft rising from the launch pad is said to lift off.

clue.text: Reduce energy and run gently

parts.note: to lop is to cut down or reduce
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A runner cuts back effort and jogs along easily.
explanation.definitionFit: To lope is to move with a long easy stride, a gentle sort of running.

clue.text: Flirting style that shows city values

definitions.meaning: playing it means touching feet under the table flirtatiously
the FTSE 100 share index, pronounced the same, tracks prices in the City of London

explanation.definitionFit: Secret foot contact is flirting; the FTSE index measures share prices in London's financial district.

clue.text: Final stage of senescence doctor looked up

indicators.note: in a down entry, looked up means the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: senescence is old age
MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor examines the last phase of ageing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'looked up' turns both pieces round together, since in a down light the letters are read upwards; 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: The last letter of the Greek alphabet is used to mean the end or last part of anything.

clue.text: Article in bombastic style is like a creation of Goethe's

indicators.note: in places the article within the word for pompous writing

parts.note: fustian is pompous, inflated language
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A critic finds a piece written pompously, in the manner of Goethe.
explanation.definitionFit: Goethe wrote Faust, about the scholar who sells his soul; the adjective describes such pacts.

clue.text: One in tears left, bound for slaver

indicators.note: to be bound is to be tied round, so the weeping one encloses the next piece

parts.note: someone in tears is a sobber

explanation.surface: A weeping person left behind, bound and sold to a slave trader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'slaver' reads as a slave trader, but here it is the verb meaning to drool.
explanation.definitionFit: To slaver is to let saliva run from the mouth, the same as to drool.

clue.text: Novelist's forbidding reading aloud

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', so the novelist is what is defined

indicators.note: reading aloud signals that the word for forbidding is heard rather than seen

parts.note: a forbidding look is a stern one

explanation.surface: A novelist's work is described as forbidding when performed.
explanation.definitionFit: Laurence Sterne was the eighteenth-century author of Tristram Shandy.

clue.text: Extended picnic?

parts.note: a picnic is a meal laid out of doors, so it is a spread outside, while the whole word means stretched out

explanation.surface: A family picnic that goes on all afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: Something stretched out wide, like opened wings, is extended.

clue.text: One flies flags

definitions.meaning: a songbird, the kind that flies, related to finches
strings of small flags hung as decoration

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a finch-like songbird and festive strings of flags.

clue.text: Looking embarrassed, slipping up about hard, misleading clue

parts.note: someone embarrassed turns red
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard
erring is making a mistake

explanation.surface: Someone flushed with embarrassment, having made a blunder over a hard clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A false lead meant to distract, as in detective stories, is the idiom.

clue.text: Somehow reproduce sequence of actions

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters of the next word are arranged in some unspecified way

explanation.surface: An instruction to copy a series of steps in some way or other.
explanation.definitionFit: A set routine, a series of steps followed in order, is the usual sense.

clue.text: Some music daughter arranged for reception

parts.note: a tune is a piece of music

explanation.surface: A daughter arranges some music for a wedding reception.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reception' suggests a party, but it means picking up a radio signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A radio set adjusted to pick up a station has been set to that frequency.

clue.text: This better offer is final

parts.note: a 'better' is someone who bets; the odds available to that gambler when the race begins are the last ones that count

explanation.surface: Someone haggling insists a higher bid is the last word.
explanation.walkthrough: 'better' looks like the comparative of good; read it as one who bets, at the racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: In horse racing the odds quoted at the off are the ones settling bets made without an agreed price.

clue.text: Bachelor's outrageous frigidity, badly brought up as artist

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for bachelor
OTT means over the top, outrageous
ice is coldness, frigidity

indicators.note: in a down entry, brought up means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: ill means badly, as in ill-treated

explanation.surface: A bachelor's shocking coldness, a sign of poor upbringing, is that of an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns ILL into LLI at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Sandro Botticelli was the Florentine painter of The Birth of Venus.

clue.text: Hot in gorge, get sunstroke?

indicators.note: the first piece is placed inside the eating word

parts.note: to gorge is to overeat
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on a tap

explanation.surface: A traveller in a hot gorge worries about catching sunstroke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gorge' looks like a ravine; it is the verb meaning to eat greedily.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunstroke is what happens when the body becomes too warm; the question mark admits it is one example.

clue.text: German poet's son admitting a verse creates tedium

indicators.note: admitting means the poet and son let the next pieces in

parts.note: Heinrich Heine was a German poet; with the possessive his name gains an S

explanation.surface: A German poet's son includes a verse that bores everyone.
explanation.walkthrough: The possessive on 'poet's' supplies an S of its own, and 'son' adds a second; 'creates' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Dullness or ponderousness, a dragging quality, is a sense of the word.

clue.text: One pleading desperately for operatic title role

definitions.meaning: someone begging urgently for help or alms
The ... Opera, John Gay's ballad opera, names this figure in its title

explanation.definitionFit: A mendicant pleads for alms; Gay's eighteenth-century ballad opera is named after such a figure.

clue.text: His improving speech is just part of the service

definitions.text: His improving speech is just part of the service

parts.words: His improving speech is just part of the service
parts.note: the improving speech is a sermon, delivered as one part of a church service

explanation.surface: A man's self-improvement talk forms only a small part of what he offers.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman giving the sermon offers moral improvement during church worship.

clue.text: Gong sounded time in early part of day twice

indicators.note: twice says the assembled piece is written out two times over

parts.note: AM stands for ante meridiem, the morning

explanation.surface: A gong was struck at a set hour each morning, two times over.
explanation.definitionFit: A tam-tam is a large flat orchestral gong of Chinese origin.

clue.text: Policeman locking chambers where poacher may have been held

definitions.text: where poacher may have been held

indicators.note: locking means the policeman encloses the chambers word

parts.note: MP is a military policeman
antra, plural of antrum, are cavities or chambers in anatomy

explanation.surface: A policeman locks a poacher in the cells.
explanation.definitionFit: A spring trap with jaws was once set on estates to catch trespassing game thieves.

clue.text: Football pitch on which Lawrence was roasted

definitions.meaning: American football's field, marked with grid lines
Saint Lawrence was martyred in Rome by being roasted on an iron grill

explanation.definitionFit: The American football field is nicknamed for its lines, like the barred grill of St Lawrence's martyrdom.

clue.text: One receiving dividends is concerned with new bank

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a tier is a row or bank, as of seats

explanation.surface: A shareholder is worried about a new bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' suggests money but is a row, like a tier of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A rentier lives on income from investments, collecting returns rather than earning wages.

clue.text: English in free passage to old region of Italy

indicators.note: in puts the English letter inside the passage word

parts.note: a vent is an opening giving free passage to air

explanation.surface: An Englishman enjoys free travel to an ancient Italian region.
explanation.definitionFit: Veneto is the north-eastern Italian region around Venice.

clue.text: Payment conditions are negotiable

indicators.note: terms that are negotiable can be altered, so the letters before are rearranged

explanation.surface: A contract's terms of payment are up for discussion.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram indicator is 'negotiable'; 'are' is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, the price or payment given for a promise is its consideration.

clue.text: Flower in twilight not closing

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: not closing says the final letter of the dusk word is cut off

parts.note: dusk is twilight

explanation.surface: A bloom that stays open at dusk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is a crossword word for a river, something that flows; the Indus runs through Pakistan.
explanation.definitionFit: A river is a thing that flows, so a crossword calls it a flower.

clue.text: Dried up burn, say?

indicators.note: say means the word for burn is heard spoken

parts.note: to sear is to burn the surface

explanation.surface: Is a scorched field a sign of a burn?
explanation.definitionFit: Sere describes vegetation that is withered and parched.

clue.text: Last of beer brought forward — that's generous

indicators.note: last of picks out the final letter of the drink word to be moved
brought forward says that letter is moved nearer the front

parts.note: lager is a type of beer

explanation.surface: Someone buying the final round of drinks is praised as generous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last of beer' looks like the final letter of BEER; in fact BEER is a synonym, LAGER, and it is LAGER's last letter R that is moved to sit before the G.
explanation.definitionFit: A large portion or a large-hearted person is a generous one: this is a synonym.

clue.text: Drug worked deep in her

indicators.note: worked, like dough or clay, means the letters are kneaded into a new shape

explanation.surface: A drug has worked its way deep inside a woman's body.
explanation.definitionFit: Ephedrine is a stimulant drug used as a decongestant.

clue.text: Thick coat will be finished in one second

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the word for finished goes inside the pair of pieces that follows

parts.note: a mo is a moment or second
something finished is past

explanation.surface: A painter promises the thick coat will be done in a second.
explanation.definitionFit: Impasto is paint laid on heavily so that brushstrokes stand out: a thick layer.

clue.text: Proceed after fault found in court book

definitions.text: Proceed after fault found in court
definitions.meaning: in tennis, after a fault is called, the player must serve again
to book is to set aside a seat or table in advance

explanation.definitionFit: Booking a seat is setting it aside, and serving again after a fault is a second serve.
